target.statement: XGBoost on original hybrid features achieves 0.9747 accuracy (and 0.9716 F1) on CICMalDroid2020 with a 70/30 stratified split
target.table_ref: Table II, row 'Original / XGBoost', column Accuracy

compute.basis: The paper gives no code and no exact preprocessing script; the 564-dim hybrid feature CSV must be rebuilt from the raw CICMalDroid2020 JSON logs (variance threshold 0.1, L2 norm, label mapping) before a few minutes of XGBoost training on ~13k x 564 data.

blockers: No code or configs released; feature extraction pipeline (50621->301 static, 470->263 dynamic, variance threshold, L2 normalization) must be reimplemented from prose
Raw CICMalDroid2020 JSON logs must be downloaded and parsed; exact split seed and label encoding unspecified so exact 0.9747 may not be bit-reproducible
Class distribution described inconsistently (text says SMS-dominant, figure caption says balanced)
title: Comparison of Multiple Classifiers for Android Malware Detection with Emphasis on Feature Insights Using CICMalDroid 2020 Dataset
